name: Thimble Beetle
script:
on poke:
  say 1; hop 8
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, food) then seek food; eat end
end
on tick every 40:
  if rand(4) == 0 then walk to garden; frame 2 end
end
on time night:
  say 2; emit zzz
end

name: Moss Lantern
script:
on time dusk: glow on; frame 2; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on poke: glow toggle; say 1; end
on weather foggy: glow on; say 2; end
on tick every 20: if rand(10) == 0 then emit sparkle end; end

name: Bubble Jelly
script:
on tick every 12: if rand(5) == 0 then emit puff end; end
on poke: float 4; frame 2; say 1; end
on weather rainy: say 2; frame 3; burst puff; end
on near critter: float; end
on signal 7: glow toggle; end

name: Acorn Rocking Chair
script:
on near:
  if has(neartraits, sleepy) then frame 2; emit zzz; say 1 end
end
on poke: frame 2; sound clock; wait 4; frame 1; end
on time night: emit zzz; end
on bumped: say 2; hop 4; end

name: Tin Snailherd
script:
on tick every 60:
  if sulking then walk to works; nudge; say 1 end
end
on poke: say 2; sound clock; frame 2; end
on jam jammed: say 3; walk to works; end
on near snail: nudge; end

name: Teacup Fern
script:
on weather rainy: frame 2; emit sparkle; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; end
on poke: say 1; emit heart; end
on berry: if rand(3) == 0 then emit sparkle end; end

name: Cricket Fiddler
script:
on time dusk: frame 2; sound chirp; emit note; end
on tick every 30: if playing then frame 3; emit note end; end
on poke: say 1; sound chirp; hop; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, music) then say 2; burst note end
end

name: Pebble Owl
script:
on time night: frame 2; say 1; end
on time dawn: frame 1; emit zzz; end
on poke: flip; say 2; end
on near critter: face; end

name: Paper Kite Fish
script:
on world breeze: float 8; burst puff; say 1; end
on poke: flip; frame 2; end
on tick every 24: if rand(6) == 0 then flip end; end
on weather stormy: say 2; float; end

name: Cork Clock
script:
on hour:
  if hour == 12 then say 1; sound ding else sound clock end
  frame 2
end
on time dawn: frame 1; end
on poke: say 2; frame 1; end
on jam jammed: frame 2; end

name: Sugar Shell
script:
on world ants: frame 2; say 1; burst heart; end
on poke: emit sparkle; frame 1; end
on near moss: emit heart; end

name: Thistle Hedgehog
script:
on poke: frame 2; say 1; wait 8; frame 1; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, fragile) then stop; say 2 end
end
on tick every 50: if rand(3) == 0 then walk to anywhere end; end
on berry: walk to garden; eat; say 3; end
on time night: frame 2; emit zzz; end

name: Brass Bellows
script:
on poke: frame 2; burst puff; sound whoosh; end
on tick every 40: frame 1; end
on jam fixed: boost 15; say 1; end
on world dark: say 2; end

name: Glowworm Garland
script:
on time night: glow on; frame 2; end
on time day: glow off; frame 1; end
on tick every 16:
  if time == night and rand(4) == 0 then frame 2 + rand(2) end
end
on poke: burst sparkle; say 1; end
on world dark: glow on; say 2; end

name: Raincloud Puff
script:
on weather rainy: frame 2; say 1; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; say 2; end
on tick every 20:
  if weather == rainy and rand(3) == 0 then emit puff end
end
on poke: sound splash; burst puff; end

name: Mushroom Stool
script:
on near moss: frame 2; emit heart; end
on poke: hop 3; sound boing; frame 1; end
on time dusk: say 1; end

name: Clockwork Mouse
script:
on poke: say 1; frame 2; walk to anywhere; end
on tick every 32:
  if rand(4) == 0 then walk to anywhere; sound clock end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, food) then seek food; eat; say 2 end
end
on world ants: seek sweet; end

name: Tiny Accordion
script:
on poke: frame 2; sound tune; emit note; frame 3; say 1; end
on shipped: emit note; end
on signal 7: frame 2; burst note; end
on new:
  if has(newtraits, music) then say 2; burst note end
end

name: Dandelion Clock
script:
on world breeze: frame 3; burst puff; say 1; end
on time dawn: frame 1; end
on poke: frame 2; emit puff; end
on tick every 80: if rand(10) == 0 then frame 2 end; end

name: Button Toad
script:
on weather rainy: walk to water; say 1; sound plop; end
on poke: hop 12; sound boing; say 2; end
on near critter: hop; end
on tick every 48: if rand(5) == 0 then hop 4; frame 2 end; end
on world leak: walk to water; say 3; end

name: Teapot Ghost
script:
on time night: glow on; float 6; say 1; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on poke: frame 2; say 2; sound whoosh; end
on world dark: burst puff; glow toggle; end

name: Candle Stub
script:
on time dusk: glow on; frame 2; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on world breeze: glow off; frame 1; say 1; end
on poke: glow toggle; end

name: Shell Wind Chime
script:
on world breeze: sound ding; burst note; frame 2; end
on weather stormy: sound ding; say 1; end
on poke: sound ding; emit note; frame 2; end
on tick every 40: frame 1; end
on bumped: say 2; sound ding; end

name: Marble Run
script:
on shipped: sound coin; frame 2; emit sparkle; end
on poke: sound boing; burst sparkle; say 1; frame 1; end
on jam fixed: say 2; boost 10; end

name: Moth Box
script:
on time night: fly; glow on; end
on time dawn: home; glow off; end
on poke: say 1; fly; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, light) then say 2 end
end

name: Sock Puppet Worm
script:
on poke: say 1; frame 2; hop 4; end
on tick every 44: if rand(5) == 0 then walk to garden; frame 1 end; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, cosy) then seek cosy; emit heart end
end
on weather snowy: say 2; end

name: Cactus Bottle
script:
on weather sunny: frame 2; say 1; end
on weather rainy: frame 1; end
on bumped: emit puff; end
on tick every 120: if rand(8) == 0 then emit sparkle end; end

name: Crystal Prism
script:
on time day: frame 2; burst sparkle; end
on weather sunny: frame 3; glow on; end
on weather cloudy: frame 1; glow off; end
on poke: burst sparkle; say 1; end

name: Bramble Squirrel
script:
on berry: walk to garden; eat; say 1; end
on poke: say 2; hop 10; frame 2; end
on tick every 36:
  if fed > 3 and rand(6) == 0 then drop; say 3 end
end
on near snail: flip; end

name: Tiny Gramophone
script:
on poke: frame 2; sound tune; burst note; signal 7; end
on hour 18: sound tune; say 1; end
on tick every 20:
  if playing and rand(3) == 0 then emit note end
end

name: Drifting Lily Pad
script:
on world leak: frame 2; say 1; end
on poke: float 3; sound splash; end
on near snail: emit heart; end
on weather rainy: frame 2; end

name: Lighthouse Shell
script:
on hour 18: sound horn; glow on; say 1; end
on weather foggy: sound horn; glow on; frame 2; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on poke: sound horn; say 2; end

name: Bumblebee Cart
script:
on world bloom: seek plant; burst heart; say 1; end
on tick every 40: if rand(3) == 0 then seek plant end; end
on poke: sound fizz; hop; say 2; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, plant) then frame 2; emit heart end
end

name: Sleepy Cushion
script:
on time night: emit zzz; frame 2; end
on time dawn: frame 1; end
on bumped: sound plop; frame 2; say 1; end
on near critter: emit zzz; end

name: Pinwheel
script:
on tick every 8:
  if world == breeze then frame 2 + rand(2) end
end
on poke: frame 2; say 1; sound whoosh; end
on weather stormy: frame 3; emit puff; end

name: Copper Kettle
script:
on time dawn: sound fizz; burst puff; say 1; end
on poke: frame 2; emit puff; say 2; end
on tick every 60: frame 1; end
on weather snowy: glow on; burst puff; end

name: Snowglobe Imp
script:
on weather snowy: burst sparkle; frame 2; say 1; end
on poke:
  mem[0] += 1
  if mem[0] > 2 then shake; say 2; mem[0] = 0 else emit sparkle end
end
on time night: glow on; end
on time dawn: glow off; end

name: Pip Seedling
script:
on tick every 200:
  if days > 4 then frame 3 elif days > 1 then frame 2 end
end
on weather rainy: say 1; emit heart; end
on poke: say 2; hop 2; end
on time dawn: emit sparkle; end

name: Tin Soldier
script:
on time dawn: sound tune; walk to dock; say 1; end
on shipped: frame 2; say 2; end
on poke: flip; hop 4; frame 1; end
on world visitor: walk to dock; emit heart; end

name: Firefly Jar Lamp
script:
on time dusk: glow on; burst sparkle; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on signal 7: frame 2; emit note; end
on poke: glow toggle; say 1; end
on new:
  if has(newtraits, spooky) then say 2 end
end
